newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P assigns ratings to Denmark's KommuneKredit.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns ratings to Denmark's KommuneKredit.

text.p: U.S. credit ratings agency Standard & Poor's said on Monday it assigned an AAA long term local currency issuer credit rating and a A-1 plus short term local currency issuer credit rating to Denmark's KommuneKredit.
S&P also assigned KommuneKredit an AA plus longterm foreign currency issuer credit rating and an A-1 plus shortterm foreign currency issuer credit rating, the agency said in a statement.
The latter rating was constrained by the rating of the Kingdom of Denmark, but the longterm outlook for both ratings was stable, S&P said.
"The ratings reflect KommuneKredit's dominant position and importance as the primary financing vehicle to the Danish local government sector," the agency said.
"Also counted in the ratings is the excellent liquidity position held by KommuneKredit and a well diversified loan portfolio with a low level of individual lending exposures."
KommuneKredit is the single largest funding source to Danish local authorities and at year-end 1996 it accounted for more than 45 percent of the total longterm lending to the sector, S&P said.
